{{Quote|Besides, the only planet in the area that we can restock is Galtea, a planet recommended to us by Loh'khar.|Captain Kaiya Adrimetrum|<ref name="Traitor" />}}
'''Galtea''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Galtea system/Legends|system of the same name]], located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. The world was situated near the edge of known [[Realspace/Legends|space]], on the border of the [[Marcol Void/Legends|Marcol Void]], an empty region of space thirty [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] across. Neutral in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Politics/Legends|politics]], Galtea was only of cursory interest to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which established a small [[Imperial outpost (Galtea)|outpost]] on the planet and allowed the population a degree of autonomy.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Galtea played host to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' when it laid over at the planet for repair and resupply. Due to the actions of an Imperial [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] known as [[the Wraith]] who had become part of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette's]] crew, an Imperial task force of three [[Starship/Legends|ships]] arrived at Galtea to [[Battle of Galtea|engage]] the ''FarStar''. Outnumbered, the ''FarStar'' was forced to retreat.

==Description==
{{Quote|Fellow crewmembers, we are poised on the edge of known space, pursuing an enemy that is extremely dangerous. Any crewmember that does not wish to proceed any further may resign his or her commission and disembark. Galtea is our last stop for a while.|Captain Kaiya Adrimetrum addresses the crew of the ''FarStar''|<ref name="Traitor" />}}
[[File:Kathol.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The Kathol sector]]
Galtea was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Traitor" /> located in the [[Galtea system/Legends|system of the same name]],<ref name="DarkStryder note" /> in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]<ref name="TDC" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], situated at grid coordinates M-21.<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Pembric system/Legends|Pembric]], [[Sebiris system/Legends|Sebiris]], and [[Timbra Ott system/Legends|Timbra Ott systems]]. At Class One [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] speeds, travel to [[Pembric II]] took a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] and eight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], transit to [[Sebiris]] took a day and three hours,<ref name="TDC" /> while [[Starship/Legends|ships]] going to [[Timbra Ott]] had to follow the [[Galtea Run]] across the [[Marcol Void/Legends|Marcol Void]], which lasted fourteen days and six hours.<ref name="KO" /> A single [[Galtea's moon|moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the planet.<ref name="Traitor" />

Galtea had a temperate climate with standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]<ref name="Traitor" /> that was breathable by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and other comparable [[Species/Legends|races]].<ref name="PoG-I" /><ref name="Atmos" /> At least two continents were present on the planet, and there was abundant arable land in the form of fertile open plains for [[Farm/Legends|farming]]. Untamed [[Tree/Legends|forests]] and [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges covered the rest of the land mass of the planet. A day on Galtea lasted for twenty-two standard hours, and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was composed of 277 local days. A small colony of 890,000 Humans lived on Galtea, ruled by agricultural and [[Mining/Legends|mining]] guilds. [[Computer/Legends|Computers]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], luxury goods, and weapons were in high demand for import, while [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]], medicinal goods, metals, and [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] were exported off-planet. A single [[Galtea spaceport|spaceport]] with limited facilities on the northernmost continent served visiting starships, while a small [[Imperial outpost (Galtea)|Imperial outpost]] was located on the southern continent.<ref name="Traitor" />

==History==
{{Quote|We got company, Captain. Two, no, three ships have just reverted from hyperspace and are accelerating towards Galtea's gravity well.|[[Sensor/Legends|Sensor]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Alta Dayson]], during the opening stages of the Battle of Galtea|<ref name="Traitor" />}}
Galtea was settled as an agricultural colony due to the climate and accessibility of fertile land suited to farming. The [[Galtean]]s were ruled by agricultural and mining guilds, and turned most of the fertile plains on the northern continent into cultivated land. Being on the limits of known [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Galtea was relatively untouched by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its reign. In exchange for access to the abundant natural resources on the planet, the Empire allowed the Galteans autonomy in their daily affairs. The Empire also established a small outpost on the planet's southern continent, which was their sole presence on Galtea.<ref name="Traitor" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], who had taken control of the Kathol sector [[4 ABY/Legends|four years previously]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the fracturing of the Empire into various [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] states, was [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|ousted]] from his [[Capital/Legends|capital]] on [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Escaping with the majority of his [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]], the Moff fled the region.<ref name="TSB">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Saga Begins|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> During his retreat, the Imperial outpost on Galtea was abandoned and destroyed.<ref name="Traitor" />

In the same year, the New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' arrived at the planet on the advice of procurement specialist [[Loh'khar]] the [[Quartermaster/Legends|Finder]] to take on supplies and perform repairs before heading<ref name="Traitor" /> into the Marcol Void, an area of space thirty [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] across and devoid of any [[Star system/Legends|planetary systems]].<ref name="KO" /> The Galteans welcomed the ''FarStar'' and its crew, and were happy to help in any way they could as long as the New Republic delegation could pay in hard [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|currency]]. The ''FarStar'' also dropped off [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]<ref name="Traitor" /> whom they had acquired after an adventure on Pembric II,<ref name="Crisis">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Crisis (adventure)|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> although the majority of them had agreed to sign onto the ship's crew. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]], [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the ''FarStar'', intended to stay on the planet for a few days and permitted the crew to take shore leave.<ref name="Traitor" />

Unknown to the crew of the ''FarStar'', one of the individuals who had joined them on Pembric II, a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] by the name of [[The Wraith|Drenn]], was secretly an Imperial [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] known as the Wraith who had been assigned by Moff Sarne to infiltrate the [[Bombaasa Cartel]]. After the events that saw Sarne retreat from Kal'Shebbol, the Wraith concluded that his mission was no longer needed and sought to rejoin with the Moff's forces. To that end, while on shore leave on Galtea, he gained access to a [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] and sent a coded message that broadcast the ''FarStar''{{'s}} location, defensive capabilities, and his intent to hinder the chain of command by [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] Adrimetrum. Having gained a position on the vessel's maintenance crew to obtain access to the ship's systems, the Wraith subverted one of the [[K4 security droid]]s that guarded the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and installed a small projectile gun loaded with a miniature [[Dart/Legends|dart]] coated in a [[Poison/Legends|poison]] from the planet Sebiris within one of the droid's recessed cavities. He also placed a [[Shaped charge/Legends|shaped charge]] near a power conduit on the bridge.<ref name="Traitor" />

[[File:FarStar_battle.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The ''FarStar'' engages in combat with Imperial forces.]]
At [[Star/Legends|sunrise]], the ''FarStar''{{'s}} crew became aware that three Imperial ships&mdash;a [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]], a [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]], and an [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]]&mdash;had entered the system. Adrimetrum immediately ordered the ship cleared for action and launched from the planet, leaving some of the crew on the surface to avoid being caught on the ground. The Imperial force [[Battle of Galtea|engaged]] the ''FarStar'', and the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] began to take mounting damage from the [[Space warfare/Legends|offensive]]. Outnumbered, Adrimetrum ordered a retreat; the Wraith put his plan into motion, triggering both the hijacked [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] and shaped charge on the bridge. Both achieved their objectives; Adrimetrum was incapacitated by the dart's toxin and lapsed into a [[Coma/Legends|coma]], and the ''FarStar''{{'s}} bridge lost power when the charge ruptured the conduit. The crew managed to restore power to the bridge by rerouting the flow through the [[Life support/Legends|life support]] backups, and the ''FarStar'' was able to withdraw to a nearby [[Galtea Binary system/Legends|binary system]] to regroup and allow the crew to treat their commander.<ref name="Traitor" />

==Inhabitants==
Galtea supported 890,000 Galteans who considered themselves to be neutral and were largely indifferent as to the state of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Politics/Legends|politics]]. They had no problems dealing with either the Empire or the New Republic as long as they had the credits to pay for the services they needed.<ref name="Traitor" />

==Locations==
Galtea supported a small limited-services [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the northern continent that included a farmers market and a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant's]] bazaar. A small Imperial outpost was located on the southern continent until its destruction in 8 ABY.<ref name="Traitor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galtea first appeared in ''[[Traitor in our Midst]]'', the sixth [[Roleplaying game|RPG adventure]] in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' in [[1995]]. It was written by [[Eric S. Trautmann]] and [[Paul Sudlow]], with illustrations by [[Philip Tan]]. Galtea later received an entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.

During the adventure, five [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] is allotted for the crew to return to the ''FarStar'' from shore leave before it will launch to engage the Imperial force. In this [[Time/Legends|time]], eighty-four crew members will reboard the vessel. The players can choose to delay takeoff for an extra five minutes to allow more crew members to board the ship, for a total of 114 returnees. However, if the takeoff is delayed, the escort [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] will be able to deploy its [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] before the ''FarStar'' can launch its own [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]. If there is no delay in launching, then the corvette's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] will be able to launch first. Regardless of which option is taken, some members of the ''FarStar''{{'s}} crew are left behind, as established by bridge [[Operations officer/Legends|Operations Officer]] [[Darryn Thyte]] in a narrative section.
